recommendation: Keep this source fix. If a future work group wants the breast cancer risk example to cite genomic evidence, add a new current, non-deprecated evidence example; do not restore references to the removed Observation-genetics example family.
issue_request: FHIR-28620 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification request to make R4B Observation-genetics guidance, extension pages, and examples clearly deprecated and to direct implementers to the Genomics Reporting Implementation Guide; its final resolution recorded that the content had been corrected in R5 and would be removed rather than kept as current core content.
initial_application: The R4B application is visible in c1ade242 and merge f916279, which added the stronger disclaimer to old Observation-genetics and related genomic artifacts. Earlier R5 history in 3cfe12f removed the outdated clinical genomics artifacts, including Observation-genetics guidance and examples such as Observation/example-genetics-brcapat.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread confirms the original R4B compromise: R4B could add stronger warnings but could not remove ballot content. Current core no longer contains the old Observation-genetics page, profiles, extension source, or examples, and the current Observation notes point to the Genomics Reporting guide. The former Observation-genetics extensions now live in the separate FHIR Extension Pack and are retired/deprecated there with Genomics Reporting Guide replacement reasons. RiskAssessment is active in fhir.ini and its breastcancer-risk example is listed in the active RiskAssessment examples list.
reconciliation: Removed the stale RiskAssessment.basis reference to Observation/example-genetics-brcapat from source/riskassessment/riskassessment-example-breastcancer.xml. No old Observation-genetics deprecation note was added back to current core because those artifacts are no longer built in core and the Extension Pack copy of the old extensions already records replacement guidance.
